title: Határon túli magyarság és kisebbségi sors (Hungarians Beyond the Border)
grammar: Causal-Consequence Discourse, Treaty Formulations & Transnational Identity Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the situation of Hungarians who found themselves outside Hungary's new borders.
I can say what the minority community did to keep its language, using azért, hogy.
I can use the words for minority fate, native-language use and dual identity.
I can read a short account of life beyond the border and answer questions about it.
